rationale: Description: 'Plant the right foot flat with knee bent 90°, left knee on ground beneath hip, right forearm on right thigh'. (1) Right leg lunge: rightHip 0→60 (thigh forward), rightKnee 10→95 (bent 90°), rightAnkle added=0 (foot flat). (2) Left leg kneeling: leftHip 80→0 (thigh vertical, knee below hip), leftKnee 90 keep, leftAnkle -35→0 (foot trailing, not pointed). (3) Right arm on thigh: rightShoulder 8→0 (no abduction), shoulderFwdR added=-60 (forward reach per corrected - = forward), rightElbow 50→90 (right-angle, forearm down to thigh). (4) neck -5→0 (no side tilt). Rig limitation: hip origin fixed at y=0.12 prevents true knee-on-ground; vertical-thigh + knee-bent is closest kneeling approximation.
